an5.97:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bhāvento na cirass'eva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati.
an5.97:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appaṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu,
an5.97:1.4: appāhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto,
an5.97:1.7: appicchakathā . . . pe . . . evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.97:1.9: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bhāvento na cirass 'eva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatī
